card.title: A− SMA
card.body: A high-quality, low-duration floating-rate credit strategy of senior and subordinated notes issued by major Australian and international banks.

hero.title: A− SMA
hero.subtitle: A high-quality, low-duration floating-rate credit strategy of senior and subordinated bank notes.

statement.title: Bank-quality income, with next to no interest-rate risk.
points: More than a third of the portfolio sits in the AA band, a materially higher average quality than a typical investment-grade floating-rate mandate.
The book is entirely floating-rate, resetting quarterly to BBSW; cash-rate moves have negligible direct effect on price.
The mandate has run continuously since 1994, through three decades of rate and credit cycles.

about.title: About the strategy
about.body: A separately managed account of senior and subordinated floating-rate notes issued by major Australian and international banks — nine lines across eight issuers, run with the same discipline as the Arculus public funds.

atAGlance.title: At a glance
atAGlance.note: Terms are indicative and confirmed in mandate documentation.

processRiskControls.title: Process & risk controls
items: Only notes rated A− or higher are eligible, and the floor applies to every holding rather than the portfolio average.
Nine lines held close to equal weight across eight issuers, with a strict 20% single-issuer and 10% single-line cap.
The mandate holds floating-rate notes only. With no fixed-coupon exposure in the book, near-zero duration is built into construction rather than managed as a position.
Positions, margins and cash are reconciled daily; discount margin and effective duration are monitored as the primary sources of mark-to-market risk.

keyRisks.title: Key risks
paragraphs: Credit spread risk is the mandate’s principal exposure — a broad widening in bank credit spreads is the main driver of mark-to-market value given the 2.54-year effective duration. The portfolio is also concentrated by sector: the bond sleeve is entirely banking exposure, with no insurance or non-bank finance diversification.

Around a fifth of the portfolio is subordinated debt, ranking behind senior creditors in a wind-up, and floating-rate income resets with BBSW — a sustained fall in the cash rate reduces running income. This is not a capital-guaranteed investment, and past performance is not indicative of future returns.
